# Legal Clearance

## Overview
[Legal](./legal.md) clearance encompasses the preliminary trademark and branding reviews conducted by shared counsel for products, features, and co-[marketing](./marketing.md) campaigns involving [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) and partner entities such as [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md). These reviews establish usage guidelines, caveats, and restrictions to avoid potential trademark conflicts.

## Key Details
- **[MeshSync](./meshsync.md):** Cleared for use, subject to a caveat regarding existing similar mesh [IoT](./iot.md) marks.
- **TeaBuddy:** Cleared for use within class 21 kitchen gadgets.
- **"[Puck](./teabuddy.md)":** Considered a crowded trademark space when used alone; must be used together as "[TeaBuddy Puck](./teabuddy.md)".
- **"[Nova](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)":** Using the term "Nova" alone conflicts with an existing tech mark; must be specified as "[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)".
- **"SteepSync":** Rejected internally and prohibited from use.
- **Co-Marketing Guidelines:** Co-marketing initiatives are permitted provided that participating logos are separated by a minimum distance of 24 pixels.
